license_required.quote: An individual may not perform a home inspection for compensation unless registered under this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: Must be at least eighteen years of age

required.quote: An applicant for a registration as a home inspector shall file a written application in the form prescribed by the registrar.

experience_source.quote: An applicant for a registration as a home inspector shall file a written application in the form prescribed by the registrar.

exams.name: American Society of Home Inspectors examination
exams.notes: One of four approved exams; applicant must pass one of: ASHI, InterNACHI, EBPHI, or ICC
exams.quote: Shall submit proof of satisfactory completion of an examination on home inspection offered by the American society of home inspectors, the international association of certified home inspectors, the examination board of professional home inspectors, or the international code council

interval_years.quote: A registration issued under this chapter expires June thirtieth of each calendar year and may be renewed upon submission of a renewal fee of fifty dollars

renewal_fee_usd.quote: may be renewed upon submission of a renewal fee of fifty dollars

exists.quote: The registrar shall issue and renew registrations to home inspectors pursuant to this chapter.

title_protection.quote: "Home inspector" means an individual registered under this chapter to conduct home inspections.

scope_protection.quote: An individual may not perform a home inspection for compensation unless registered under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of Chapter 43-54, resulting in criminal penalty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An individual who violates this chapter is guilty of a class B misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to file a timely renewal application results in cancellation of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The registrar shall cancel the registration of an individual who fails to file a timely application for the renewal of registration.

insurance_required.quote: Shall submit proof of current errors and omissions insurance coverage in an amount of one hundred thousand dollars or more covering all home inspection activities

definition_quote.value: the process by which a home inspector provides a nonintrusive, visual examination and written evaluation of the heating system, cooling system, plumbing system, electrical system, structural components, foundation, roof, masonry structure, and exterior and interior components of a residential building
definition_quote.quote: "Home inspection" means the process by which a home inspector provides a nonintrusive, visual examination and written evaluation of the heating system, cooling system, plumbing system, electrical system, structural components, foundation, roof, masonry structure, and exterior and interior components of a residential building.
